tha-ap522:1.1: Padumadhāriya.] Himavantass' avidūre Romaso nāma pabbato / Buddho pi Sambhavo nāma abbhokāse vasī tadā. // //
tha-ap522:2.1: Bhavanā nikkhamitvāna padumaṃ dhārayiṃ ahaṃ / ekāhaṃ dhārayitvāna bhavanaṃ punar āgamiṃ. // //
tha-ap522:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap522:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padumadhāriyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap522:11.1: Kureñjika Kapiṭṭhañ ca Kosumbhaṃ atha Ketakaṃ Nāgapupph' Ajjunañ c' eva Kuṭajī Ghosasaññako
tha-ap522:12.1: Thero ca Sabbaphalado tathā Padumadhāriko asīti c' ettha gāthāyo tisso gāthā taduttariṃ.
